notes.title: Updating the game for Linux.
notes.content: The game requires Ubuntu version 21.04 or higher to run.

notes.title: Linux port available now!
notes.content:
Dear players, 

We are presenting Linux Wine port of the game. 
Do NOT use save/load buttons, instead use hotkeys:

F4 - Menu
F5 - Quick Save
F6 - Quick Load

If You have problem with keyboard, try to restart the game.  
Alt+Tab might produce undesired behavior on some systems, beware.

Thank You and have a good play!  ːsteamhappyː
